name: session
label: Number
help: The exact Number identifier from Polymorfa. Keep it as a string.

name: recipient
label: Recipient
help: Use an international phone number including +, a conversation ID, or a business-scoped user ID.

name: language
label: Template Language
help: The exact language code for the selected template.

name: components
label: Template Components
help: JSON array matching the template definition.

name: idempotencyKey
label: Idempotency Key
help: Required for writes. Map a stable business key unique to this write. Preserve it across retries.

name: writeCreatedAt
label: Write Started At
help: Required for writes. ISO timestamp saved when this logical write first began. Preserve it across retries; writes older than 23 hours require reconciliation.
